verdict.rationale: Antigravity's settings document a Telemetry toggle that enables or disables sharing interaction logs to improve models, so a first-party opt-out exists. Its stated scope is limited to interaction logs for model training, and it is a single thin mention. Missing for 10: confirmation that the toggle covers broader usage analytics and tracking (product analytics, crash and diagnostic reporting), parity across the CLI, SDK and IDE, and independent or hands-on corroboration that opting out stops data collection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: toggle Telemetry (enable/disable sharing interaction logs to improve models)
